answer: Rate limiting per unit of economic work is a concrete brake on sybils: an account can only answer so many challenges per epoch, and rewards come from a fixed emission pool split across valid work. Inflating participant count with hollow identities thins every share, so a summit of ten thousand fake climbers splits the same reward into dust. Attestation weight also keys off account age and history, so a coordinated signal burst from brand-new keys arrives discounted. Attackers spend real effort for a smaller slice of an unchanged pie.
